channel.title: macSteam
channel.description: Combined macSteam + NotProton releases. Add each one with scripts/appcast-add.sh.

item.title: Version 0.8.12
item.description: The OnlineFix card on a store page now follows the build Steam actually starts, instead of assuming any macOS bundle means the Mac version. Steam leaves an empty `Game.app/Contents/MacOS` behind when it installs the Windows build beside it. That skeleton used to be read as a Mac build, so a game with Windows files and a shoelace of an .app still showed the Mac wording and its own .exe was ignored. - A Mac build now has to be a bundle with a real program in it. - A Windows build now has to be a real PE executable, with the helpers games ship (crash handler, uninstaller, vcredist) skipped so they cannot pass for the game. - With both on disk the card says the Windows version, since that is what starts, and mentions the leftover Mac build beside it. Nothing here is keyed to particular games. Also in this build: patching a Mac bundle keeps its hardened runtime and entitlements, which dyld needs for the libraries Steam injects; and an unlicensed Mac game starts as 480 so the session and the ticket agree.

item.title: Version 0.8.11
item.description: Automatic updates are on. This is the release that installs them. - "Check for Updates…" works, and the app checks once a day by default. - Updates come from this repo's own signed feed, never from plain macSteam's, so an update can no longer replace this app with the other one. - The build number is now the real version; it was a fixed 19 before, so no release could ever look newer. Copies installed before this release cannot update themselves: install this one by hand, and later ones arrive on their own. Also in this build: the OnlineFix scanner reads more places for a Photon app id (Unity text assets, YAML, small binary settings), checks both encodings an id is stored in, and no longer loses a patch to a repair after a Steam verify.
